scope: Native Layer registry ownership and retirement; no change to general TJS collector/finalizer timing

evidence.owner: LayerIntf.cpp Construct assigns Owner=tjs_obj with explicit no-addref comment; ActionOwner retains the window closure.
evidence.children: LayerIntf.cpp Join/Part/AddChild register raw native pointers in Children; ObjectList.h tVoidObjectList::Add writes the pointer without AddRef.
evidence.primary: LayerManager.cpp AttachPrimary/DetachPrimary assign/clear a raw Primary pointer without AddRef.
evidence.retirement: LayerIntf.cpp Invalidate releases transition/event/image/cache resources, parts from its parent and severs surviving children rather than owning all child script objects.

implementation: KrkrHost::gc_roots no longer unconditionally roots every native layer registry entry. Existing script fields, suspended VM frames, transitions, queued image operations and callbacks retain their explicit roots. object_collected retires a layer via existing engine Canvas/Layer operations and drops its native image lease; the adapter commits retirement commands after collection before rendering/slot reuse.
independent_verification: Self-authored tests exercise dropped script references despite tree membership, active-work extra roots, external immutable image lease survival, and independently owned children surviving parent collection. Full-capacity test now intentionally retains all 2048 Layers in a script array.
limits: This establishes Layer registry ownership, not exact reference-count finalizer timing or ownership correctness of every other native registry. Actual games are verified separately.
